en.response: Hello! I'm Juan David's AI assistant. I can tell you about his skills, projects, experience, and education. What can I help you with?
I'm ready to help! Ask me about Juan David's projects, tech stack, or AI experience.

Juan David's core stack is Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and Docker. In AI/ML he works with TensorFlow, HuggingFace, scikit-learn, NLTK, spaCy, and XAI. He also builds MCP tools for Claude. Frontend (React, TypeScript) is secondary in his current role.

Juan David has 4 key projects: an enterprise MCP for Claude (140+ tools at Trajectory Inc.), Pequelectores (AI book recommendation for children), Bootcamp IA (33 ML labs with XAI), and Book-Tracker (full-stack library manager). Which one would you like to know more about?

Juan David has 5+ years of experience. He started as a Technology Media Operator automating with Python. In 2022 he interned as a Full-Stack Developer at SENA. In 2025-2026 he completed MinTIC's AI Bootcamp. Since June 2026 he works as an AI Developer at Trajectory Inc. (Canada), building an enterprise MCP for Claude with 140+ integrated tools — remotely from Colombia.

Juan David holds a Software Engineering degree from Politecnico Grancolombiano (2026). He completed the MinTIC AI Bootcamp (20 weeks of ML, Deep Learning, NLP, XAI, MLOps) and a Diploma in Computer Science. He also has a Software Development degree from SENA.
You can contact Juan David through the contact form on this site, or connect on LinkedIn. He's open to AI/ML engineering opportunities, backend development, and collaborations.

Juan David's professional philosophy: 'There is no elevator to what's worth it. You climb the stairs, one step at a time.' He believes in fundamentals-first learning and building solid foundations before frameworks.

Pequelectores is a book recommendation system for children aged 6-14. It uses TF-IDF AI recommendations, reading streaks, badge gamification, and JWT parent auth. Built with React, FastAPI, Python, PostgreSQL, scikit-learn, and Docker.

Bootcamp IA — MinTIC is a repository with 33 labs covering ML, Deep Learning (CNN 87.14%, RNN/LSTM, GANs), NLP, XAI (LIME, SHAP, Grad-CAM), Big Data (Spark, Hadoop), and distributed systems (Kafka). It documents the full ML lifecycle.

The NLP section of Bootcamp IA covers sentiment analysis, Named Entity Recognition (NER), text classification, tokenization, and fine-tuning with NLTK, spaCy, and HuggingFace Transformers. Part of 33 total labs.

Juan David works as an AI Developer at Trajectory Inc., a Canadian company. He's part of the Initus area (backend & AI core), building an enterprise MCP (Model Context Protocol) for Claude. The MCP has grown from ~6 to 140+ tools and connects Claude to all company data, APIs, and workflows. He works remotely from Colombia.

Book-Tracker is a full-stack app for managing personal book collections and tracking reading progress. Built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and Docker. Deployed on Netlify and Railway.
